title: WS2 CP4A Mode Sync + Display Status

firmware_binding.feature: Mode sync and display status foundation

journey.name: CP4A mode sync and display status
journey.summary: Windows follows keyboard-authoritative mode, confirms Desktop mode-set through 0x92 OK plus 0x00 readback, preserves local drafts offline, and reads keyboard truth first on reconnect.

protocol.failure_rule: non-OK, timeout, disconnect or mismatch returns visible state to keyboard-authoritative mode
